#Normalisation 

## inverse-normal transformation of variables(Transforming data into normal data)
### First the categorical variabels should be excluded and the transformation should only be done on the numerical data
### Exclude specific columns and select only numeric columns

```{r}
Data.soft_subset <- Data.soft[, -c(2, 6, 8, 11, 14, 17)]
numeric_cols <- names(Data.soft_subset)[sapply(Data.soft_subset, is.numeric)]  # Get names of numeric columns

#### Apply the transformation to each numeric column in the original Data.soft and then viewing the data 

Data.soft[numeric_cols] <- lapply(Data.soft[numeric_cols], function(col) { 
  qnorm((rank(col, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(col)))
})
```


#Visualisation of Normalised data 
###histgram of only numerical variables 
```{r}
hist(data.matrix(Data.soft[,-c(2, 6, 8, 11, 14, 17)]))

##Shapiro test for checking the normality 

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Perform Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
shapiro_results <- data.frame(Variable = names(Data.soft)[1:28], p.value = NA)

for (i in 1:28) {
  variable <- Data.soft[, i]
  shapiro_results$p.value[i] <- shapiro.test(variable)$p.value
}

# Display Shapiro-Wilk test results
print(shapiro_results)

# Visual inspection using histograms and Q-Q plots
for (i in 1:28) {
  variable <- Data.soft[, i]
  
  # Histogram
  p <- ggplot(data = Data.soft, aes(x = !!sym(names(Data.soft)[i]))) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) +
    ggtitle(paste("Histogram of", names(Data.soft)[i])) +
    theme_minimal()
  ggsave(paste0("histogram_", names(Data.soft)[i], ".png"), plot = p)
  
  # Q-Q plot
  png(paste0("qqplot_", names(Data.soft)[i], ".png"))
  qqnorm(variable, main = paste("Q-Q Plot of", names(Data.soft)[i]))
  qqline(variable, col = "red")
  dev.off()
}

```

```{r}
  varlist = c("u3talteru", "u3csex", "u3tgewi", "u3tgroe", "u3tbmi", 
              "u3tbmiwho", "u3twhrat", "u3twhratc", "u3tsysmm",

              "u3thoma2_s", "u3thoma2_b"),
  p.rd = 3,  # Number of decimal places for p-values
  skewvar = NULL ,#Specify the Non normal variable lists 
  norm.rd = 2,  # Number of decimal places for normal variables

)
```

#Specifiying participants with extreme archetypes and mixed etiology 
```{r}
#chang the assignements
# Get the indices of extreme archetypes
Extreme.archetype_indices <- which(assignments_a4 > 0.7, arr.ind = TRUE)  # Get indices of extreme archetypes with #information about the row and coloms 
Extreme.archetype_indices
Participants.number <- Extreme.archetype_indices[,c(1,2)]

Participants.number <- data.frame(Participant_Number = Participants.number[, 1],
                                  Archetype_Number = Participants.number[, 2])
Participants.number

# Initialize Extreme_Archetype_Number with NA
Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- NA  

# Populate Extreme_Archetype_Number for extreme participants
for (i in 1:nrow(Participants.number)) {
  participant_id <- Participants.number$Participant_Number[i]
  archetype_id <- Participants.number$Archetype_Number[i]
  
  # Assign the archetype number to the corresponding participant in Data.soft
  Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number[participant_id] <- archetype_id
}

mixed_etiology <- which(apply(assignments_a4, 1, function(x) all(x < 0.7)))#change the assignment

# Assign a specific value for mixed etiology participants in Extreme_Archetype_Number
Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number[mixed_etiology] <- "Mixed Etiology"  # You can change this label as needed


```


##Risk assessment for Metabolic syndrome (to comapre the MetS in archtype scores) meaning that:
#MetS ~ archetype score + age + sex )
#The codes compares the MetS vs healthy / non-MetS individuals
#There is no “reference archetype group” in your model (scores are continuous).
```{r}
library(openxlsx)
Data.soft.risk <- Data.soft
Data.soft.risk$MetS <- ifelse(Data.soft.risk$u3tmsidfup == 1, 1,
                              ifelse(Data.soft.risk$u3tmsidfup == 2, 0, NA))
Data.soft.risk$u3csex <- factor(Data.soft.risk$u3csex)

# Make archetype score dataframe + safe names
assignments_df <- as.data.frame(assignments_a4)
colnames(assignments_df) <- paste0("Archetype", 1:4)

# Add to main data
Data.soft.risk <- cbind(Data.soft.risk, assignments_df)

# Loop over archetype scores (one model per archetype)
a_cols <- paste0("Archetype", 1:4)

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(a_cols, function(a){
  f <- as.formula(paste("MetS ~", a, "+ u3talteru + u3csex"))
  fit <- glm(f, data = Data.soft.risk, family = binomial())
  
  b  <- coef(summary(fit))[a, "Estimate"]
  se <- coef(summary(fit))[a, "Std. Error"]
  p  <- coef(summary(fit))[a, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  data.frame(
    predictor = a,
    OR = exp(b),
    CI_low  = exp(b - 1.96*se),
    CI_high = exp(b + 1.96*se),
    p = p
  )
}))

results$Adjusted_P <- p.adjust(results$p, method = "BH")
results
write.csv(results, "results_MetS_archetypes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.xlsx(results, "results_MetS_archetypes.xlsx", rownames = FALSE)


##visualisation
library(ggplot2)

results$predictor <- factor(results$predictor,
                            labels = c("Archetype 1","Archetype 2","Archetype 3","Archetype 4"))

p_forest <- ggplot(results, aes(x = predictor, y = OR)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
                width = 0.2, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "red", size = 2) +   # <-- make the dot red
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "MetS risk in each archetype ", x = NULL, y = "Odds Ratio") +
  theme_minimal()

p_forest



ggsave("forest.plot_MetS.png",
       plot = p_forest,
       width = 9,
       height = max(3, 0.6 + 0.5 * nrow(results)),
       dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")

ggsave("forest.plot_MetS.pdf",
       plot = p_forest,
       width = 9,
       height = max(3, 0.6 + 0.5 * nrow(results)),
       dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")
getwd()
```


#Calculating the AUC
```{r}
library(pROC)

# fit and store models
fits <- setNames(lapply(a_cols, function(a){
  f <- as.formula(paste("MetS ~", a, "+ u3talteru + u3csex"))
  glm(f, data = Data.soft.risk, family = binomial())
}), a_cols)

# AUC for each stored model
aucs <- sapply(fits, function(m){
  y    <- model.response(model.frame(m))
  yhat <- fitted(m)
  as.numeric(auc(roc(y, yhat, quiet = TRUE)))
})

plot(aucs)
auc(aucs)
aucs


```



#not a good code (risk prediction using this method MetS ~ Extreme_Archetype_Number + age + sex)
```{r}
## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)

## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
Data.soft.risk <- Data.soft %>%
  mutate(
    MetS = case_when(
      u3tmsidfup == 1 ~ 1,
      u3tmsidfup == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE            ~ NA_real_
    ),
    u3csex = factor(u3csex),

    # Ensure group is character first, then set factor levels so reference is Mixed Etiology
    Extreme_Archetype_Number = as.character(Extreme_Archetype_Number),
    Extreme_Archetype_Number = factor(
      Extreme_Archetype_Number,
      levels = c("Mixed Etiology", "1", "2", "3", "4")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MetS),
    !is.na(u3talteru),
    !is.na(u3csex),
    !is.na(Extreme_Archetype_Number)
  )

Data.soft.risk$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- relevel(Data.soft.risk$Extreme_Archetype_Number, ref = "Mixed Etiology")

# Quick check of counts (helps detect separation / empty cells)
tab <- with(Data.soft.risk, table(MetS, Extreme_Archetype_Number))
print(tab)

## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
use_firth <- requireNamespace("logistf", quietly = TRUE)

if (use_firth) {
  library(logistf)

  fit <- logistf(
    MetS ~ Extreme_Archetype_Number + u3talteru + u3csex,
    data = Data.soft.risk
  )

  coef_names <- names(fit$coefficients)
  keep <- grepl("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", coef_names)

  b  <- fit$coefficients[keep]
  se <- fit$se[keep]
  p  <- fit$prob[keep]

  # CI from confint (more reliable than Wald if available)
  ci <- suppressMessages(confint(fit))
  ci <- ci[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  results1 <- data.frame(
    group   = sub("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", "", coef_names[keep]),
    OR      = exp(b),
    CI_low  = exp(ci[, 1]),
    CI_high = exp(ci[, 2]),
    p       = p,
    row.names = NULL
  )

} else {
  fit <- glm(
    MetS ~ Extreme_Archetype_Number + u3talteru + u3csex,
    data = Data.soft.risk,
    family = binomial()
  )

  ct <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  keep <- grepl("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", rownames(ct))

  b  <- ct[keep, "Estimate"]
  se <- ct[keep, "Std. Error"]
  p  <- ct[keep, "Pr(>|z|)"]

  results1 <- data.frame(
    group   = sub("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", "", rownames(ct)[keep]),
    OR      = exp(b),
    CI_low  = exp(b - 1.96 * se),
    CI_high = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
    p       = p,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
results1$Adjusted_P <- p.adjust(results1$p, method = "BH")

# Make sure group is character (prevents NA when labeling)
results1$group <- as.character(results1$group)

# Nice labels for plot/table (these ORs are vs ref = Mixed Etiology)
results1$group_label <- factor(
  results1$group,
  levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4"),
  labels = c("Archetype 1", "Archetype 2", "Archetype 3", "Archetype 4")
)

print(results1)

write.csv(results1, "results_MetS_by_group_ref_MixedEtiology.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.xlsx(results1, "results_MetS_by_group_ref_MixedEtiology.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)

## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
plot_df <- results1 %>% filter(!is.na(group_label))

p_forest <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = group_label, y = OR)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8, color = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "red") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Odds of MetS by archetype group (ref: Mixed Etiology)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Odds Ratio (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_forest)

ggsave("forest_plot_MetS_ref_MixedEtiology.png",
       plot = p_forest,
       width = 9,
       height = max(3, 0.6 + 0.5 * nrow(plot_df)),
       dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")

ggsave("forest_plot_MetS_ref_MixedEtiology.pdf",
       plot = p_forest,
       width = 9,
       height = max(3, 0.6 + 0.5 * nrow(plot_df)),
       bg = "white")

getwd()

```
```{r}
## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)

## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
Data.soft.risk <- Data.soft %>%
  mutate(
    MetS = case_when(
      u3tmsidfup == 1 ~ 1,
      u3tmsidfup == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE            ~ NA_real_
    ),
    u3csex = factor(u3csex),

    # Make group a factor and (optionally) include "Mixed Etiology" as a level
    Extreme_Archetype_Number = as.character(Extreme_Archetype_Number),
    Extreme_Archetype_Number = factor(
      Extreme_Archetype_Number,
      levels = c("Mixed Etiology", "1", "2", "3", "4")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MetS),
    !is.na(u3talteru),
    !is.na(u3csex),
    !is.na(Extreme_Archetype_Number)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Extreme_Archetype_Number = relevel(Extreme_Archetype_Number, ref = "3")
  )

# Quick check of counts
tab <- with(Data.soft.risk, table(MetS, Extreme_Archetype_Number))
print(tab)

# Confirm reference (first level is reference)
print(levels(Data.soft.risk$Extreme_Archetype_Number))

## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
use_firth <- requireNamespace("logistf", quietly = TRUE)

if (use_firth) {
  library(logistf)

  fit <- logistf(
    MetS ~ Extreme_Archetype_Number + u3talteru + u3csex,
    data = Data.soft.risk
  )

  coef_names <- names(fit$coefficients)
  keep <- grepl("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", coef_names)

  b  <- fit$coefficients[keep]
  se <- fit$se[keep]
  p  <- fit$prob[keep]

  ci <- suppressMessages(confint(fit))
  ci <- ci[keep, , drop = FALSE]

  results1 <- data.frame(
    group     = sub("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", "", coef_names[keep]),
    OR        = exp(b),
    CI_low    = exp(ci[, 1]),
    CI_high   = exp(ci[, 2]),
    p         = p,
    row.names = NULL
  )

} else {
  fit <- glm(
    MetS ~ Extreme_Archetype_Number + u3talteru + u3csex,
    data = Data.soft.risk,
    family = binomial()
  )

  ct <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  keep <- grepl("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", rownames(ct))

  b  <- ct[keep, "Estimate"]
  se <- ct[keep, "Std. Error"]
  p  <- ct[keep, "Pr(>|z|)"]

  results1 <- data.frame(
    group     = sub("^Extreme_Archetype_Number", "", rownames(ct)[keep]),
    OR        = exp(b),
    CI_low    = exp(b - 1.96 * se),
    CI_high   = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
    p         = p,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

## ----------------------------
## ----------------------------
results1$Adjusted_P <- p.adjust(results1$p, method = "BH")
results1$group <- as.character(results1$group)
results1$group_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  results1$group == "1" ~ "Archetype 1",
  results1$group == "3" ~ "Archetype 3",
  results1$group == "4" ~ "Archetype 4",
```

#logistf code 
```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(logistf)  # Add this for Firth's penalized logistic regression
library(ggplot2)

Data.soft.risk <- Data.soft
Data.soft.risk$MetS <- ifelse(Data.soft.risk$u3tmsidfup == 1, 1,
                              ifelse(Data.soft.risk$u3tmsidfup == 2, 0, NA))
Data.soft.risk$u3csex <- factor(Data.soft.risk$u3csex)

# Make archetype score dataframe + safe names
assignments_df <- as.data.frame(assignments_a4)
colnames(assignments_df) <- paste0("Archetype", 1:4)

# Add to main data
Data.soft.risk <- cbind(Data.soft.risk, assignments_df)

# Check for complete separation issues (diagnostic)
cat("Checking for potential separation issues:\n")
for(a in paste0("Archetype", 1:4)) {
  cat("\n", a, "by MetS status:\n")
  print(tapply(Data.soft.risk[[a]], Data.soft.risk$MetS, summary))
}

# Loop over archetype scores with logistf
a_cols <- paste0("Archetype", 1:4)

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(a_cols, function(a){
  # Create formula
  f <- as.formula(paste("MetS ~", a, "+ u3talteru + u3csex"))
  
  # Fit Firth's penalized logistic regression
  fit <- logistf(f, data = Data.soft.risk, 
                 control = logistf.control(maxit = 100))
  
  # Find the index for the archetype coefficient
  coef_idx <- which(names(fit$coefficients) == a)
  
  # Extract results (logistf uses profile likelihood confidence intervals)
  data.frame(
    predictor = a,
    OR = exp(fit$coefficients[coef_idx]),
    CI_low = exp(fit$ci.lower[coef_idx]),
    CI_high = exp(fit$ci.upper[coef_idx]),
    p = fit$prob[coef_idx]  # p-value from penalized likelihood ratio test
  )
}))

# Add adjusted p-values
results$Adjusted_P <- p.adjust(results$p, method = "BH")

# Display results
print(results)

# Save results
write.csv(results, "results_MetS_archetypes_logistf.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.xlsx(results, "results_MetS_archetypes_logistf.xlsx", rownames = FALSE)

# Visualization
results$predictor <- factor(results$predictor,
                            labels = c("Archetype 1", "Archetype 2", 
                                      "Archetype 3", "Archetype 4"))

p_forest <- ggplot(results, aes(x = predictor, y = OR)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "gray50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high),
                width = 0.2, color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16)) +
  labs(title = "MetS Risk by Archetype Score (Firth's Logistic Regression)",
       subtitle = "Odds ratios with profile likelihood 95% CI",
       x = NULL, 
       y = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50"))

print(p_forest)

# Save plots
ggsave("forest_plot_MetS_logistf.png",
       plot = p_forest,
       width = 9,
       height = max(4, 0.8 + 0.5 * nrow(results)),
       dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")

ggsave("forest_plot_MetS_logistf.pdf",
       plot = p_forest,
       width = 9,
       height = max(4, 0.8 + 0.5 * nrow(results)),
       dpi = 600,
       bg = "white")

# Print working directory
getwd()

# Compare with original results (if you want to see the difference)
cat("\n\n=== Comparison with original GLM results ===\n")
cat("Your original GLM gave extreme ORs (e.g., 50,458 for Archetype1)\n")
cat("Firth's method should give more realistic estimates\n")
```

```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

Data.soft.risk <- Data.soft
Data.soft.risk$MetS <- ifelse(Data.soft.risk$u3tmsidfup == 1, 1,
                              ifelse(Data.soft.risk$u3tmsidfup == 2, 0, NA))

# covariates
Data.soft.risk$u3csex <- factor(Data.soft.risk$u3csex)

# --- add archetype scores ---
assignments_df <- as.data.frame(assignments_a4)
colnames(assignments_df) <- paste0("Archetype", 1:4)
Data.soft.risk <- cbind(Data.soft.risk, assignments_df)

# =========================================================
# A) Ridge Logistic Regression (glmnet) -> OR (penalized)
# =========================================================
library(glmnet)

# keep complete cases for variables used
ridge_dat <- Data.soft.risk %>%
  select(MetS, u3talteru, u3csex, Archetype1:Archetype4) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MetS), !is.na(u3talteru), !is.na(u3csex))

X <- model.matrix(MetS ~ Archetype1 + Archetype2 + Archetype3 + Archetype4 + u3talteru + u3csex,
                  data = ridge_dat)[, -1]  # drop intercept
y <- ridge_dat$MetS

set.seed(1)
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(X, y, family = "binomial", alpha = 0)  # alpha=0 => ridge
best_lambda <- cv_ridge$lambda.min

fit_ridge <- glmnet(X, y, family = "binomial", alpha = 0, lambda = best_lambda)

ridge_coefs <- as.matrix(coef(fit_ridge))
ridge_or <- exp(ridge_coefs)

ridge_results <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(ridge_or),
  OR_ridge = as.numeric(ridge_or)
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")

ridge_results$OR_per0.1 <- ridge_results$OR_ridge^0.1
ridge_results
write.csv(ridge_results, "ridge_OR_MetS_archetypes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.xlsx(ridge_results, "ridge_OR_MetS_archetypes.xlsx", rownames = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# B) PR (Prevalence Ratio) with Mixed Etiology as reference
#     (Poisson regression + robust SE)
# =========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(openxlsx)

# ---- IMPORTANT: set your group variable here ----
# Example: Data.soft.risk$Archetype_group <- Data.soft.risk$Extreme_Archetype_Number
# But it must contain a level called "Mixed Etiology"
# If your variable is numeric codes, recode it to labels first.

# >>> CHANGE THIS LINE to your real column name:
Data.soft.risk$Archetype_group <- factor(Data.soft.risk$Extreme_Archetype_Number)

Data.soft.risk$Archetype_group <- factor(Data.soft.risk$Archetype_group)

# set reference level to Mixed Etiology
#Data.soft.risk$Archetype_group <- #relevel(Data.soft.risk$Archetype_group, ref = "Mixed Etiology")

pr_dat <- Data.soft.risk %>%
  dplyr::select(MetS, Archetype_group, u3talteru, u3csex) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(MetS),
    !is.na(Archetype_group),
    !is.na(u3talteru),
    !is.na(u3csex)
  )
pr_dat$MetS <- as.integer(pr_dat$MetS)
# pr_dat <- pr_dat[!is.na(pr_dat$MetS), ]

# Sex as factor
pr_dat$u3csex <- factor(pr_dat$u3csex)

fit_pr <- glm(MetS ~ Archetype_group + u3talteru + u3csex,
              data = pr_dat, family = poisson())

# robust SE
V <- vcovHC(fit_pr, type = "HC0")
ct <- coeftest(fit_pr, vcov. = V)

# build PR table
pr_results <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(ct),
  beta = ct[, "Estimate"],
  se = ct[, "Std. Error"],
  p = ct[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
) %>%
  mutate(
    PR = exp(beta),
    CI_low = exp(beta - 1.96 * se),
    CI_high = exp(beta + 1.96 * se)
  ) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(Adjusted_P = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

pr_results
write.csv(pr_results, "PR_MetS_by_group_ref_MixedEtiology.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.xlsx(pr_results, "PR_MetS_by_group_ref_MixedEtiology.xlsx", rownames = FALSE)

  mutate(group = gsub("^Archetype_group", "", term))

p_forest_pr <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(group, PR), y = PR)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_low, ymax = CI_high), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "MetS prevalence ratio by cluster (ref = Mixed Etiology)",
       x = NULL, y = "PR (log scale)") +
  theme_minimal()

p_forest_pr

ggsave("forest_PR_MetS_ref_MixedEtiology.png",
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openxlsx)

# helper: exact binomial CI
binom_ci <- function(x, n, conf.level = 0.95) {
  ci <- binom.test(x, n, conf.level = conf.level)$conf.int
  c(low = unname(ci[1]), high = unname(ci[2]))
}
Data.soft.risk <- Data.soft %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    MetS = dplyr::case_when(
      u3tmsidfup == 1 ~ 1,
      u3tmsidfup == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Archetype_group = factor(
      as.character(Extreme_Archetype_Number),
      levels = c("Mixed Etiology", "1", "2", "3", "4")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(MetS), !is.na(Archetype_group))

print(with(Data.soft.risk, table(MetS, Archetype_group)))
prev_tbl <- Data.soft.risk %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Archetype_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    MetS_cases = sum(MetS == 1),
    prevalence = MetS_cases / n,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CI_low = binom_ci(MetS_cases, n)["low"],
    CI_high = binom_ci(MetS_cases, n)["high"]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prevalence_pct = 100 * prevalence,
    CI_low_pct = 100 * CI_low,
    CI_high_pct = 100 * CI_high
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Archetype_group,
    n,
    MetS_cases,
    prevalence_pct,
    CI_low_pct,
    CI_high_pct
  )

print(prev_tbl)

write.csv(prev_tbl, "Prevalence_MetS_by_archetype.csv", row.names = FALSE)

  ) +
  coord_flip() +
```

#Correlation matrix of pairwise of the countinous variales 
```{r}
#For saving figures
setwd(Sys.getenv("KORA_RUN_DIR"))
# List of columns to exclude
excluded_vars <- c("Age", "Gender", "Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF", "WHO_BMI_Category", 
                   "WHR_Category", "Diabetes_WHO", "Hypertension")

# Keep only numeric columns and remove excluded columns for clinical variables
clinical_vars <- setdiff(colnames(Data.soft), excluded_vars)
clinical_numeric_vars <- clinical_vars[sapply(Data.soft[, clinical_vars, drop=FALSE], is.numeric)]
Data.clinical <- Data.soft[, clinical_numeric_vars, drop=FALSE]

# Compute correlation matrix for only clinical variables vs archetypes
correlation_matrix <- cor(Data.clinical, adjusted_assignments, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# Function for significance testing for correlation matrix
cor.mtest <- function(mat, conf.level = 0.95) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  n <- ncol(mat)
  p.mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      if (i != j) {  # Avoid redundant diagonal computations
        test <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], method = "pearson")
        p.mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
      }
    }
  }
  colnames(p.mat) <- rownames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  return(list(p = p.mat))
}

# compute p-values for correlation
cor_test_results <- cor.mtest(correlation_matrix, conf.level = 0.95)

# convert p-values into significance stars, handling NA values
significance_matrix <- matrix(sapply(cor_test_results$p, function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  else if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}), nrow = nrow(correlation_matrix), ncol = ncol(correlation_matrix))

# ensure dimensions match before plotting
if (!all(dim(significance_matrix) == dim(correlation_matrix))) {
  stop("Error: Dimensions of significance matrix do not match correlation matrix!")
}
pdf("Corrplot_Fixed-k4.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)
library(corrplot)
corrplot(correlation_matrix, 
         method = "color",       
         tl.col = "black",       
         tl.cex = 1.2,         
         tl.srt = 45,            
         mar = c(5, 6, 4, 8),    # More space for the legend
         cl.ratio = 0.4,         # Make the legend wider
         cl.align.text = "l",    
         cl.cex = 0.8,           # Make legend text larger
         cl.length = 11,         # More ticks on the color bar
         cl.lim = c(-1, 1)       # Ensure legend covers full correlation range
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
#compute correlation matrix for only clinical variables vs archetypes
correlation_matrix <- cor(Data.soft[,1:28], adjusted_assignments, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor.mtest <- function(mat, conf.level = 0.95) {
  mat <- as.matrix(mat)
  n <- ncol(mat)
  p.mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  
  for (i in 1:n) {
    for (j in 1:n) {
      if (i != j) {  # Avoid redundant diagonal computations
        test <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], method = "pearson")
        p.mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
      }
    }
  }
  colnames(p.mat) <- rownames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  return(list(p = p.mat))
}

#compute p-values for correlation
cor_test_results <- cor.mtest(correlation_matrix, conf.level = 0.95)

#convert p-values into significance stars, handling NA values
significance_matrix <- matrix(sapply(cor_test_results$p, function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")  # Handle NA values gracefully
  else if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}), nrow = nrow(correlation_matrix), ncol = ncol(correlation_matrix))

#nsure dimensions match before plotting
if (!all(dim(significance_matrix) == dim(correlation_matrix))) {
  stop("Error: Dimensions of significance matrix do not match correlation matrix!")
}

# Save heatmap as JPEG
jpeg("Heatmap_of_4_Archetypes.jpeg", width = 1800, height = 1000, res = 600)

# Define color palette
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)

# Create heatmap
pheatmap(correlation_matrix, 
         cluster_rows = TRUE,  
         cluster_cols = FALSE,  
         scale = "row",
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         color = my_palette,
         main = "Heatmap of Archetypes",
         fontsize_row = 6,
         fontsize_col = 8, #angle_col = 45,
         angle_col = 0,
         border_color = "grey70",
         display_numbers = significance_matrix)

# Close device to save file
dev.off()

# Define color palette

# Function to compute p-values for correlation matrix
cor.mtest <- function(mat, conf.level = 0.95) {
  n <- ncol(mat)
  p.mat <- matrix(NA, n, n)
  colnames(p.mat) <- colnames(mat)
  rownames(p.mat) <- rownames(mat)
  
  for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):n) {
      test <- cor.test(mat[, i], mat[, j], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
      p.mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
      p.mat[j, i] <- test$p.value
    }
  }
  return(list(p = p.mat))
}

# Compute p-values
cor_test_results <- cor.mtest(combined_data)

}

  else return("")
}
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:28) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(adjusted_assignments)) {
    group1 <- Data.soft[adjusted_assignments[, j] == 1, i]
    group2 <- Data.soft[adjusted_assignments[, j] == 0, i]
    
    if (length(group1) > 2 && length(group2) > 2) {
      test_result <- wilcox.test(group1, group2, exact = FALSE)
      mw_p_values[i, j] <- test_result$p.value
      # Use median difference as direction
      median_diff_matrix[i, j] <- median(group1, na.rm = TRUE) - median(group2, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

# Adjust p-values for multiple comparisons (FDR)

  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  else if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}), nrow = nrow(mw_p_values), ncol = ncol(mw_p_values))
```

```{r}
# Select variables to include for the heatmap (excluding the specified ones)
included_data_soft <- Data.soft[, !(colnames(Data.soft) %in% excluded_vars)]

# Only keep numeric columns to avoid errors in wilcox.test
included_data_soft <- included_data_soft[, sapply(included_data_soft, is.numeric)]

# Update the number of rows for matrices based on the included variables
num_included_vars <- ncol(included_data_soft)


# Ensure Extreme_Archetype_Number is treated as a character
Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- as.character(Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number)

adjusted_assignments <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = nrow(Data.soft), ncol = 5))
colnames(adjusted_assignments) <- c("1","2","3","4","Mixed Etiology")

# Fill the adjusted assignments based on Extreme Archetype Number
for (i in 1:nrow(Data.soft)) {
  if (!is.na(Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number[i])) {
    if (Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number[i] == "Mixed Etiology") {
      adjusted_assignments[i, 5] <- 1 # Mixed Etiology
    } else {
      archetype_index <- as.numeric(Data.soft$Extreme_Archetype_Number[i])
      adjusted_assignments[i, archetype_index] <- 1 # Set corresponding archetype to 1
    }
  }
}


# Initialize matrices with the correct dimensions
mw_p_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = num_included_vars, ncol = ncol(adjusted_assignments))
median_diff_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = num_included_vars, ncol = ncol(adjusted_assignments))

# Perform Mann-Whitney U test and calculate median difference (as effect direction)
for (i in 1:num_included_vars) { # Loop through the included variables
  for (j in 1:ncol(adjusted_assignments)) {
    group1 <- included_data_soft[adjusted_assignments[, j] == 1, i]
    group2 <- included_data_soft[adjusted_assignments[, j] == 0, i]

    if (length(group1) > 2 && length(group2) > 2) {
      test_result <- wilcox.test(group1, group2, exact = FALSE)
      mw_p_values[i, j] <- test_result$p.value
      # Use median difference as direction
      median_diff_matrix[i, j] <- median(group1, na.rm = TRUE) - median(group2, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

# Adjust p-values for multiple comparisons (FDR)
p_values_adjusted <- matrix(p.adjust(mw_p_values, method = "fdr"),
                            nrow = nrow(mw_p_values),
                            ncol = ncol(mw_p_values))

# Convert adjusted p-values to significance stars
significance_matrix <- matrix(sapply(p_values_adjusted, function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  else if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}), nrow = nrow(mw_p_values), ncol = ncol(mw_p_values))

# Assign row and column names
rownames(median_diff_matrix) <- rownames(significance_matrix) <- colnames(included_data_soft)
colnames(median_diff_matrix) <- colnames(significance_matrix) <- colnames(adjusted_assignments)

# Scale for heatmap visualization
scaled_medians <- scale(median_diff_matrix)

# Define heatmap color palette
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)

# Save heatmap
png("Heatmap_MedianDiff_Archetype1.png", width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)

pheatmap(scaled_medians,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,

         main = "Heatmap of Archetypes",
         fontsize_row = 15,
         fontsize_col = 15,
         angle_col = "0",
         border_color = "grey70",

dev.off()
```

#Creating Heatmap of Mixed Etiology using the Linear regression
```{r}
#Defining  the clinical variables for analysis
clinical_vars <- c("u3talteru", "u3csex", "u3tgewi", "u3tgroe", "u3tbmi", 
                                                  "u3tbmiwho", "u3twhrat", "u3twhratc", "u3tsysmm", 
                                                  "u3tdiamm", "u3twhoish", "u3tglukfastn", 
                                                  "u3tgluk2n", "u3tdm110y15", "u3tinsfastn", 
                                                  "u3tins2n", "u3tmsidfup", "u3tquickin",  
                                                  "u3lk_choln", "u3lk_hdln", "u3lk_ldln", 
                                                  "u3lk_trin", "u3lk_krean", "u3l_hbavn", 
                                                  "u3h_crp", "u3thoma2_ir","u3thoma2_s", "u3thoma2_b")


Data.soft$Mixed_Group <- NA
Data.soft$Mixed_Group[mixed_etiology] <- mixed_groups

#  Initialize matrices to store test estimates and p-values
test_estimates <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(clinical_vars), ncol = length(unique(mixed_groups)))
p_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(clinical_vars), ncol = length(unique(mixed_groups)))

rownames(test_estimates) <- clinical_vars
colnames(test_estimates) <- unique(mixed_groups)
rownames(p_values) <- clinical_vars
colnames(p_values) <- unique(mixed_groups)
for (group in unique(mixed_groups)) {
  group_indices <- which(Data.soft$Mixed_Group == group)
  
  for (var in clinical_vars) {
    if (!is.null(group_indices) && length(group_indices) > 0) {
      Data.soft$group_member <- ifelse(Data.soft$Mixed_Group == group, 1, 0)
      
      # Run linear regression (considering the clinical variable as continuous)
      model <- lm(Data.soft[[var]] ~ Data.soft$group_member)
      test_estimates[var, group] <- coef(model)[2]  # Coefficient for group membership
      p_values[var, group] <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4]  # p-value
    }
  }
}
get_significance <- function(p) {
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}

# Apply the significance function to p-values
significance <- matrix(sapply(p_values, get_significance), nrow = nrow(p_values))
rownames(significance) <- rownames(test_estimates)
colnames(significance) <- colnames(test_estimates)

my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)
pheatmap((test_estimates), 
         cluster_rows = FALSE,  # Perform clustering on rows (samples)
         cluster_cols = FALSE,  # Perform clustering on columns (metabolites)
         scale = "row", # Scale rows for better visualization
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         display_numbers = significance, 
         color = my_palette,
         angle_col = 0,#0 for horizontal, 45 for rotation andfor vertical 90
         main = "Heatmap of Clinical Associations Across Mixed Etiology Groups")

```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
                   "u3lk_choln", "u3lk_hdln", "u3lk_ldln", "u3lk_trin", 
                   "u3lk_krean", "u3l_hbavn", "u3h_crp", "u3thoma2_ir", 
                   "u3thoma2_s", "u3thoma2_b")

pretty_names <- c(
  "Age", "Weight", "Height", "BMI", 
   "WHR",  "SBP", "DBP",
   "Fasting_glucose", "Glucose_2h",  
  "Fasting_serum_insulin", "Insulin_2h", "Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki",
  "Cholesterol", "HDL", "LDL", "TG", "Creatinine", "HbA1c", "hsCRP", 
  "HOMA_IR", "HOMA_Sensitivity", "HOMA_Beta"
)
Data.soft$Mixed_Group <- NA
Data.soft$Mixed_Group[mixed_etiology] <- mixed_groups
test_estimates <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(clinical_vars), ncol = length(unique(mixed_groups)))
p_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(clinical_vars), ncol = length(unique(mixed_groups)))

rownames(test_estimates) <- clinical_vars
colnames(test_estimates) <- unique(mixed_groups)
rownames(p_values) <- clinical_vars
colnames(p_values) <- unique(mixed_groups)
for (group in unique(mixed_groups)) {
  group_indices <- which(Data.soft$Mixed_Group == group)
  
  for (var in clinical_vars) {
    if (!is.null(group_indices) && length(group_indices) > 0) {
      group1 <- Data.soft[[var]][Data.soft$Mixed_Group == group]
      group2 <- Data.soft[[var]][Data.soft$Mixed_Group != group & !is.na(Data.soft$Mixed_Group)]
      
      # Only test if both groups have enough participants
      if (length(group1) > 2 && length(group2) > 2) {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(group1, group2, exact = FALSE)
        
        p_values[var, group] <- test_result$p.value
        test_estimates[var, group] <- median(group1, na.rm = TRUE) - median(group2, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    }
  }
}
get_significance <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  else if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}

significance <- matrix(sapply(p_values, get_significance), nrow = nrow(p_values))
rownames(test_estimates) <- pretty_names
rownames(significance) <- pretty_names

# Remove legend title
attr(test_estimates, "name") <- ""          # works in recent pheatmap
attr(test_estimates, "matrix_name") <- NULL # just in case you set it earlier

png("Heatmap_of_4_mixed etiology.fixed.png", width = 10,height = 8, units = "in", res = 600)
# Set matrix name to customize the color legend title
attr(test_estimates, "matrix_name") <- "Estimate"
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)

pheatmap(test_estimates, 
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         fontsize_number = 18,  # Increase asterisk size here
         scale = "row",
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         display_numbers = significance,
         color = my_palette,
         angle_col = "0",
         fontsize_row = 13,
         fontsize_col = 13,
         main = "Heatmap of Clinical Associations Across Mixed Etiology Groups")

dev.off()
```

#Creatin a list to at the same time plotting all the boxplots together
```{r}

setwd(Sys.getenv("KORA_RUN_DIR"))

library(ggpubr)

# Define variables and their corresponding y-axis labels
boxplot_vars <- list(
  "u3tbmi" = "BMI",
  "u3tgewi" = "Weight",
  "u3twhrat" = "Waist-Hip Ratio",
  "u3tsysmm" = "Systolic Blood Pressure",
  "u3tdiamm" = "Diastolic Blood Pressure",
  "u3tglukfastn" = "Fasting Glucose",
  "u3tgluk2n" = "2 hours Glucose",
  "u3tinsfastn" = "Fasting Serum Insulin",
  "u3tins2n" = "2 hours Insulin",
  "u3thoma2_b" = "HOMA-Beta Cell Function",
  "u3thoma2_s" = "HOMA Insulin Sensitivity",
  "u3thoma2_ir" = "HOMA-Insulin Resistance",
  "u3tquickin" = "Quantitative Insulin Sensitivity Check Index",
  "u3lk_choln" = "Total Cholesterol",
  "u3lk_hdln" = "HDL",
  "u3lk_ldln" = "LDL",
  "u3lk_trin" = "Fasting Triglyceride",
  "u3lk_krean" = "Creatinine",
  "u3l_hbavn" = "Fasting HbA1c Value",
  "u3h_crp" = "High Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein",
  "u3tgroe" = "Height",
  "u3talteru" = "Age at Examination Date"
)

# Define color palette
color_palette <- c("red","blue", "lightgreen","purple","#E7B800", "#00AFBB","grey")

# Loop through variables and save plots
for (var in names(boxplot_vars)) {
  # Create the boxplot
  p <- ggboxplot(Data.soft, x = "Extreme_Archetype_Number", y = var,
                 color = "Extreme_Archetype_Number", palette = color_palette,
                 order = c("1", "2","3","4", "Mixed Etiology"),#adjust the number of archetypes here
                 ylab = boxplot_vars[[var]], xlab = "Archetype") +
       theme_minimal() +  # Use minimal theme for better visualization
       ggtitle(boxplot_vars[[var]]) +  # Add the title
       theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  # Center the title

  # Save each plot with a unique filename
  filename <- paste0("boxplot_", var, ".png")
  ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

```{r}
setwd(Sys.getenv("KORA_RUN_DIR"))

## Excluding the categorical variables
Data.soft <- Data.soft[, !names(Data.soft) %in% c("Gender", "Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF","WHO_BMI_Category", "WHR_Category", "Diabetes_WHO","Hypertension")]

# Load necessary library
library(fmsb)

# Aggregate means per archetype
archetype_means <- aggregate(. ~ Extreme_Archetype_Number, data = Data.soft, FUN = mean)

# Extract archetype labels and mean data
archetype_labels <- archetype_means$Extreme_Archetype_Number
archetype_means_data <- archetype_means[, -1]

# Define max and min for radar scaling
max_values <- apply(archetype_means_data, 2, max)
min_values <- apply(archetype_means_data, 2, min)
for (i in 1:nrow(archetype_means_data)) {
  # Create filename for each archetype
  filename <- paste0("Radar_Plot_Archetype_", archetype_labels[i], ".pdf")
  
  # Start PDF device for individual plot
  pdf(filename, width = 8, height = 8)
  
  # Set margins for single plot
  par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1), font.axis = 1)
  
  # Prepare radar data for this archetype
  radar_data <- rbind(max_values, min_values, archetype_means_data[i, ])
  
  # Fix title label for "Mixed Etiology"
  plot_title <- ifelse(tolower(archetype_labels[i]) == "mixed etiology", 
                       "Mixed etiology", 
                       paste("Archetype", archetype_labels[i]))
  
  # Create radar chart
  radarchart(radar_data, 
             axistype = 1, 
             title = plot_title,
             pcol = "blue",
             pfcol = rgb(0.2, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3),
             plwd = 2,
             cglcol = "grey", 
             cglty = 1, 
             axislabcol = "grey", 
             caxislabels = seq(0, 1, 0.2), 
             calcex = 0.8,    # Axis text size
             vlcex = 1.1,   # Variable label text size
             cex.main = 1.5,  # Title size
             font.main = 2,   # Bold title
             titlecex = 1.5)  # Title size
  
  # Close PDF device
  dev.off()
  
  cat("Created:", filename, "\n")
}
```

#Assigning each person of MetS to different archetypes after deciding the best numbers of archetypes
```{r}
#chang the assignements
# Get the indices of extreme archetypes
Extreme.archetype_indices <- which(assignments_a3_M > 0.7, arr.ind = TRUE)  # Get indices of extreme archetypes with #information about the row and coloms 
Extreme.archetype_indices
Participants.number <- Extreme.archetype_indices[,c(1,2)]

Participants.number <- data.frame(Participant_Number = Participants.number[, 1],
                                  Archetype_Number = Participants.number[, 2])
Participants.number

# Initialize Extreme_Archetype_Number with NA
Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- NA  

# Populate Extreme_Archetype_Number for extreme participants
for (i in 1:nrow(Participants.number)) {
  participant_id <- Participants.number$Participant_Number[i]
  archetype_id <- Participants.number$Archetype_Number[i]
  
  # Assign the archetype number to the corresponding participant in Data.soft
  Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number[participant_id] <- archetype_id
}

mixed_etiology <- which(apply(assignments_a3_M, 1, function(x) all(x < 0.7)))#change the assignment

# Assign a specific value for mixed etiology participants in Extreme_Archetype_Number
Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number[mixed_etiology] <- "Mixed Etiology"  # You can change this label as needed
```

```{r}
# ---- choose a guaranteed output directory ----
out_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "radar_png")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Helper: safe filename
safe_name <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", x)  # replace spaces/symbols with _
  x
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(archetype_means_data))) {

  label_i <- archetype_labels[i]
  file_i  <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("Radar_Plot_MetS_Archetype_", safe_name(label_i), ".png"))

  # Open a robust png device
  # Option A: base R + cairo (good on most systems if cairo is available)
  png(filename = file_i, width = 8, height = 8, units = "in", res = 600, type = "cairo-png")

  # If cairo isn't available on your system, comment the line above and use this instead:

  # Guarantee device close even on error
  on.exit({
    try(dev.off(), silent = TRUE)
  }, add = TRUE)

  ok <- tryCatch({
    par(mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1), font.axis = 1)

    radar_data <- rbind(max_values, min_values, archetype_means_data[i, ])

    plot_title <- ifelse(tolower(label_i) == "mixed etiology",
                         "Mixed etiology",
                         paste("Archetype", label_i))

    radarchart(radar_data,
               axistype = 1,
               title = plot_title,
               pcol = "blue",
               pfcol = rgb(0.2, 0.5, 0.5, 0.3),
               plwd = 2,
               cglcol = "grey",
               cglty = 1,
               axislabcol = "grey",
               caxislabels = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
               calcex = 0.8,
               vlcex = 1.2,
               cex.main = 1.5,
               font.main = 2)

    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("FAILED for label=", label_i, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
    FALSE
  })

  # Close device now (and also removed from on.exit stack naturally at end of loop)
  dev.off()

  if (ok && file.exists(file_i)) {
    cat("Created:", file_i, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("NOT created:", file_i, "\n")
  }
}

cat("PNG output folder:", out_dir, "\n")
```

#heatmap of MetS (USED IN the paper for publication)
```{r}
setwd(Sys.getenv("KORA_RUN_DIR"))

# Load required library
library(pheatmap)
# Rename columns using dplyr
Data.soft.Metabolic <- Data.soft.Metabolic %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Age = u3talteru, 
    Gender = u3csex, 
    Weight = u3tgewi, 
    Height = u3tgroe, 
    BMI = u3tbmi,
    WHO_BMI_Category = u3tbmiwho,  
    WHR = u3twhrat,  
    WHR_Category = u3twhratc, 
    SBP = u3tsysmm, 
    DBP = u3tdiamm, 
    Hypertension = u3twhoish,  
    Fasting_glucose = u3tglukfastn,  
    Glucose_2h = u3tgluk2n,  
    Diabetes_WHO = u3tdm110y15,  
    Fasting_serum_insulin = u3tinsfastn,  
    Insulin_2h = u3tins2n,  
    HOMA_Beta = u3thoma2_b,  
    HOMA_Sensitivity = u3thoma2_s,  
    HOMA_IR = u3thoma2_ir,  
    Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki = u3tquickin,
    Cholesterol = u3lk_choln,  
    HDL = u3lk_hdln, 
    LDL = u3lk_ldln,  
    TG = u3lk_trin, 
    Creatinine = u3lk_krean, 
    HbA1c = u3l_hbavn,   
    hsCRP = u3h_crp
  )


# Define variables to exclude
excluded_vars <- c("Age", "Gender",  "WHO_BMI_Category", "WHR_Category", "Diabetes_WHO", "Hypertension", "u3n_prot_OmicEra_ff4",      "u3n_metabBiocrP500_ff4" )

# Select variables to include for the heatmap (excluding the specified ones)
included_data_soft <- Data.soft.Metabolic[, !(colnames(Data.soft.Metabolic) %in% excluded_vars)]

# Only keep numeric columns to avoid errors in wilcox.test
included_data_soft <- included_data_soft[, sapply(included_data_soft, is.numeric)]

# Update the number of rows for matrices based on the included variables
num_included_vars <- ncol(included_data_soft)


# Ensure Extreme_Archetype_Number is treated as a character
Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- as.character(Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number)

adjusted_assignments <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = nrow(Data.soft.Metabolic), ncol = 4))# one more than the number of archetypes
colnames(adjusted_assignments) <- c("M1","M2","M3","Mixed Etiology")

# Fill the adjusted assignments based on Extreme Archetype Number
for (i in 1:nrow(Data.soft.Metabolic)) {
  if (!is.na(Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number[i])) {
    if (Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number[i] == "Mixed Etiology") {
      adjusted_assignments[i, 4] <- 1 # Mixed Etiology
    } else {
      archetype_index <- as.numeric(Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number[i])
      adjusted_assignments[i, archetype_index] <- 1 # Set corresponding archetype to 1
    }
  }
}


# Initialize matrices with the correct dimensions
mw_p_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = num_included_vars, ncol = ncol(adjusted_assignments))
median_diff_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = num_included_vars, ncol = ncol(adjusted_assignments))

# Perform Mann-Whitney U test and calculate median difference (as effect direction)
for (i in 1:num_included_vars) { # Loop through the included variables
  for (j in 1:ncol(adjusted_assignments)) {
    group1 <- included_data_soft[adjusted_assignments[, j] == 1, i]
    group2 <- included_data_soft[adjusted_assignments[, j] == 0, i]

    if (length(group1) > 2 && length(group2) > 2) {
      test_result <- wilcox.test(group1, group2, exact = FALSE)
      mw_p_values[i, j] <- test_result$p.value
      # Use median difference as direction
      median_diff_matrix[i, j] <- median(group1, na.rm = TRUE) - median(group2, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

# Adjust p-values for multiple comparisons (FDR)
p_values_adjusted <- matrix(p.adjust(mw_p_values, method = "fdr"),
                            nrow = nrow(mw_p_values),
                            ncol = ncol(mw_p_values))

# Convert adjusted p-values to significance stars
significance_matrix <- matrix(sapply(p_values_adjusted, function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  else if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}), nrow = nrow(mw_p_values), ncol = ncol(mw_p_values))

# Assign row and column names
rownames(median_diff_matrix) <- rownames(significance_matrix) <- colnames(included_data_soft)
colnames(median_diff_matrix) <- colnames(significance_matrix) <- colnames(adjusted_assignments)

# Scale for heatmap visualization
scaled_medians <- scale(median_diff_matrix)

# Define heatmap color palette
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)

# Save heatmap
png("Heatmap_MedianDiff_Archetype1.png", width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)

pheatmap(scaled_medians,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         color = my_palette,
         main = "Heatmap of Archetypes",
         fontsize_number = 20,  # Increase asterisk size here
         fontsize_row = 15,
         fontsize_col = 15,
         angle_col = "0",
         border_color = "grey70",
         display_numbers = significance_matrix)

dev.off()
getwd()
```

#Heatmap of mixed etiology (used in the publication)
```{r}

setwd(Sys.getenv("KORA_RUN_DIR"))
library(pheatmap)
clinical_vars <- c("u3talteru", "u3tgewi", "u3tgroe", "u3tbmi", 
                   "u3twhrat", "u3tsysmm", "u3tdiamm", 
                   "u3tglukfastn", "u3tgluk2n", 
                   "u3tinsfastn", "u3tins2n", "u3tquickin",  
                   "u3lk_choln", "u3lk_hdln", "u3lk_ldln", "u3lk_trin", 
                   "u3lk_krean", "u3l_hbavn", "u3h_crp", "u3thoma2_ir", 
                   "u3thoma2_s", "u3thoma2_b")

pretty_names <- c(
  "Age", "Weight", "Height", "BMI", 
   "WHR",  "SBP", "DBP",
   "Fasting_glucose", "Glucose_2h",  
  "Fasting_serum_insulin", "Insulin_2h", "Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki",
  "Cholesterol", "HDL", "LDL", "TG", "Creatinine", "HbA1c", "hsCRP", 
  "HOMA_IR", "HOMA_Sensitivity", "HOMA_Beta"
)
Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group <- NA
Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group[mixed_etiology] <- mixed_groups
test_estimates <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(clinical_vars), ncol = length(unique(mixed_groups)))
p_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(clinical_vars), ncol = length(unique(mixed_groups)))

rownames(test_estimates) <- clinical_vars
colnames(test_estimates) <- unique(mixed_groups)
rownames(p_values) <- clinical_vars
colnames(p_values) <- unique(mixed_groups)
for (group in unique(mixed_groups)) {
  group_indices <- which(Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group == group)
  
  for (var in clinical_vars) {
    if (!is.null(group_indices) && length(group_indices) > 0) {
      group1 <- Data.soft.Metabolic[[var]][Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group == group]
      group2 <- Data.soft.Metabolic[[var]][Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group != group & !is.na(Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group)]
      
      # Only test if both groups have enough participants
      if (length(group1) > 2 && length(group2) > 2) {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(group1, group2, exact = FALSE)
        
        p_values[var, group] <- test_result$p.value
        test_estimates[var, group] <- median(group1, na.rm = TRUE) - median(group2, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    }
  }
}
get_significance <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  else if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}

significance <- matrix(sapply(p_values, get_significance), nrow = nrow(p_values))
rownames(test_estimates) <- pretty_names
rownames(significance) <- pretty_names

# Remove legend title
attr(test_estimates, "name") <- ""          # works in recent pheatmap
attr(test_estimates, "matrix_name") <- NULL # just in case you set it earlier

png("Heatmap_of_MetS_mixed etiology.fixed.png", width = 10,height = 8, units = "in", res = 600)
# Set matrix name to customize the color legend title
attr(test_estimates, "matrix_name") <- "Estimate"
my_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50)

pheatmap(test_estimates, 
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         scale = "row",
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         fontsize_number = 20,  # Increase asterisk size here
         display_numbers = significance,
         color = my_palette,
         angle_col = "0",
         fontsize_row = 13,
         fontsize_col = 13,
         main = "Heatmap of Mixed Etiology Groups in MetS")

dev.off()
getwd()
```
